meta.name: letter-senses-freeze
meta.description: Version tag and content lock for letter_senses.csv. The letter dataset is FROZEN while roots are being curated: a root that finds no match is a RESULT to record, never a reason to edit a letter.
policy: The letter dataset does not move during a root-curation batch.
A root with no eligible sense is recorded as an unmatched result; no letter is retouched to make it fit.

A letter may change ONLY through a new version here, justified by a machine-checkable citation: {authority, pages}, whose every page range must exist in the letter-level authority file. Never by a root that did not work.
scripts/build_root_cores_seed.py must never read or write letter_senses.csv.
meta.digest_note: sha256 over the RAW BYTES of letter_senses.csv. Reformatting trips it too, and that is intended: a curated dataset does not get touched by accident.

history.reason: Initial freeze, taken at the end of the constrain-lisan-by-root-core change and before any further root curation. 59 senses over the 28 base letters.

Merged the sheet's only duplicate. `masha-medial` and `masha-final` carried an identical gloss and identical axes for ح, differing only in `position` — one statement of the author transcribed twice, not two uses. He states it once, over two positions at once: «في الآخر والوسط: تغلب المشاعر الإنسانية والأصوات والرقة والصفاء مع الحرارة والميل». The merged row `masha` therefore carries `position: medial;final`, which is also why `position` became a `;`-separated set: `any` would contradict the different «في الأول» he states separately, and two rows keep the duplicate. No other row changed.

NO ROW CHANGED — the digest is identical to 1.0.1, and the minor bump records a change of MEANING, not of content. `position` became an eligibility gate in the engine, so `final` stopped saying «prefers the end» and started saying «only at the end». Every stored value was re-read under that stronger sense against the authority's `position_notes`: all 21 specific positions are explicitly stated by Ḥasan ʿAbbās and none was deduced, so nothing was demoted to `any`. THREE rows are flagged rather than changed, because their authority is comparative and not exclusive: ث/unutha-final («في آخر الألفاظ 78% أكثر منه في أولها 36%» — he attests the initial too), and م/riqqa-initial and م/damm-final («سبعة أضعاف» / «ضعفا» — ratios between the two ends, not a restriction to one). Under gate semantics those three overclaim. Deciding them is a curation call, not a refactor, and it is left open.
